استشممن (form X)
# اِسْتَشْمَمْنَ (istašmamna) /is.taʃ.mam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# اُسْتُشْمِمْنَ (ustušmimna) /us.tuʃ.mim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# اِسْتَشْمِمْنَ (istašmimna) /is.taʃ.mim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
